measure: edge length of the container divided by the edge length of the pieces
format: [x, y, z, qw, qx, qy, qz] per piece: unit-edge copy of the canonical piece solid (solids.py) rotated by the scalar-first quaternion q and centred at (x, y, z); container = s_full x canonical unit-edge container solid, centred at the origin, canonical orientation
method: soft-to-rigid homotopy (inscribed balls hardened into the solid under inward pressure), then SLSQP tightening with per-pair separating planes
title: 3 unit cubes in an octahedron
